conviction_note: The print turns on Q3 tangible book value (TBV, $8.58 at 6/30) and the October quarter-to-date update given on the call. Peers have already shown the damage (ORC book -16.6%, IVR book -16.1%, both on Oct 14), the 10-year rose about 85bp in Q3 against a 0.7-year positive duration gap at AGNC, and the stock has de-rated 15.5% in 20 sessions to a 52-week low with downside skew bid. So most of the bad Q3 book is priced, and the open question is October and the premium to book. Lean slightly negative: p_up 45 on abs 3.5 gives -0.35, against an impact_sum of -0.9. The gap between the two is small, and both are small because the dominant facts are public.
bar: EPS (net spread + dollar roll income) consensus $0.39, 4 estimates, per Earnings Whispers (https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/w/AGNC) and a Benzinga/aggregator summary (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/AGNC/earnings-forecasts); Q2 printed $0.40 vs $0.389. The line the stock trades on is TBV, and no consensus TBV is published. The implied street mark comes from peers' Sep-30 books (ORC -16.6%, IVR -16.1%) and the Oct 7-16 price-target cuts (KBW $9, Piper $10, BofA $8.50, JPM $8). So the TBV bar is inferred, not sourced, and the TBV-dependent findings are capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest 131.2M shares, 11.1% of float, 2.6 days to cover, up 20.9% month over month (Equibles snapshot 2026-10-19, https://equibles.com/stocks/AGNC). Ortex (2026-10-19, https://ortex.news/articles/191344/agnc-short-interest-climbs-20-into-q3-earnings) has 12% of free float, up ~20% in a month, cost to borrow under 1%, put/call 1.19; the same article misstates Q2 TBV, so it is low quality. Sweep row: 108.1M shares and 7.2 days to cover at the 2026-07-15 settlement. This is a rising but not crowded short: borrow is cheap and days to cover low, so it gives little squeeze fuel. Baseline 25-delta skew is +4.33 vol points (downside paid), put/call OI 0.74, event-implied move 2.61% (straddle 3.5%). Spot is at the 52-week low, -15.5% over 20 days and -3.0 to -3.7% intraday on the print day itself.

findings.finding: Two agency-MBS peers pre-announced Q3 books on 2026-10-14. Orchid Island's book went from $7.22 (6/30) to $6.02 (9/30), -16.6%, with a -12.5% total return on equity. Invesco Mortgage Capital's went from $8.03 (6/30) to $7.74 (8/31) to $6.74 (9/30), -16.1%, with -13% in September alone. Applied to AGNC's $8.58 June TBV, a peer-like quarter means roughly $7.2-7.5 at 9/30.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2023 is the closest analog: TBV -14.0% ($9.39 to $8.08) with an October QTD decline of ~11%. AGNC fell ~13% over the week of its preliminary results (https://www.fool.com/investing/2023/10/26/why-agnc-investment-stock-dropped-13-this-week). In the 8 baseline prints, all in quieter book quarters, |move| has a median of 1.41% and 6 of 8 were up.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. If the market had not priced it, AGNC would still trade near its $8.95 Oct 1 close at a premium to June TBV. Instead it is -15.5% over 20 days at $8.42, and four brokers cut targets after these releases. What remains open is whether AGNC's own decline matches the peers, since AGNC has historically shown lower book beta than ORC.
findings.independence: IVR's own 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001437071/000143707126000076/ivr10142026-8kxex991.htm, 2026-10-14) is a separate company and document. Guggenheim's sector note (https://portal.guggenheiminvestments.com/GuggenheimInvestments/media/PDF/FISV-4Q26-AMBS.pdf, data to 9/30/26) calls Q3 agency MBS's weakest quarter of 2026, with spread underperformance worsening in late September.

findings.finding: AGNC went into Q3 deliberately long duration. Its duration gap was +0.7 years at 6/30, and management said on the Q2 call it 'prefers a positive duration gap'. The Q2 10-Q sensitivity, as summarised by an AI-generated page and not yet verified against the 10-Q itself, puts +75bp in rates at -8.8% of TBV. The 10-year then rose ~85bp in the quarter (4.42% on 6/30 to multidecade highs above 5.2% by late September), the biggest quarterly rise since 2016. AGNC's own positioning therefore points to a book decline at least as large as the peers', before any MBS spread widening.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the Q2 call, TBV +2.4% for the quarter but about -1% QTD in July, and the stock moved -1.28% (baseline 2026-07-20). In Q3 2023, a large rate-driven TBV loss plus a negative QTD update coincided with a ~13% weekly drop.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. Sell-side models carry the duration gap. If the market had fully priced a worse-than-peer book, AGNC would not still be the most expensive agency mREIT on price to book (1.11x per Insider Monkey on Oct 15). The premium suggests the market still credits AGNC with better book protection than ORC and IVR, which its stated rate positioning does not support in a +85bp quarter.
findings.independence: The sensitivity figure comes from https://www.panabee.com/news/agnc-investment-earnings-q2-2026-report, an AI-generated summary of the Q2 10-Q that also gives the 0.7-year gap; it shares the company as source. The rate move is independent: Morningstar/Dow Jones has 4.420% on 2026-06-30 (https://www.morningstar.com/news/dow-jones/202606307321/10-year-treasury-yield-rises-to-4420-data-talk), and a WSJ quarter summary (via search) has +85bp for the quarter.

findings.finding: October quarter-to-date conditions for the call's TBV update are mixed to negative. The 10-year eased from its Oct 6-7 peak of 5.31% to 5.06-5.15% (Mortgage News Daily). But Freddie Mac's 30-year mortgage rate rose from 7.28% (Oct 1) to 7.40% (Oct 8 and Oct 15), which suggests the mortgage-to-Treasury spread widened further in October rather than retracing. AGNC stock is about -6% since its $8.95 Oct 1 close.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: AGNC customarily gives a QTD TBV figure on the call. July 2026: ~-1%, and the stock moved -1.28%. October 2023: ~-11% QTD, and the stock fell ~13% over the week. April 2025: an intra-quarter update of -5.5% (to $7.80) came during a broad rally, and the stock moved +2.83% (baseline 2025-04-10).
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly priced. The market can see rates and an AGNC price that is down about 6% in October, but has no company number for October. A flat or positive QTD figure would be a relief; a further -3% to -5% would extend the de-rating. The stock's -3% fall on the print day suggests holders lean toward the bad case.
findings.independence: Freddie Mac series via Trading Economics (https://tradingeconomics.com/united-states/30-year-mortgage-rate/news/588887, 2026-10-01, with the Oct 8 and Oct 15 updates). Primary mortgage rates are a lagging proxy for secondary MBS spreads, so this is a proxy and not company data.

findings.finding: Wider spreads raise AGNC's forward returns, and the dividend has just been reaffirmed. On the Q2 call management said 15-17% ROEs on 130-150bp spreads at 7-7.5x leverage 'align really well' with the $0.12 monthly dividend. It also said the GSEs, with ~$120bn of purchase capacity, would buy aggressively at 160-170bp. Spreads have since widened 'well above the year-to-date average' (Guggenheim), Pulte said on Sep 18 that the GSEs are buying 'large quantities', and AGNC declared the October $0.12 dividend on Oct 7-8. The call is likely to present wider spreads as a higher-ROE entry point and to reaffirm the dividend.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: April 2025: after a -5.5% intra-quarter book hit, the Q1 2025 print moved +3.55% (baseline 2025-04-21) as management pointed to wide-spread returns. Over the 8 baseline prints, 6 were up.
findings.why_not_priced: A 16.5% dividend yield and a 52-week low price in a dividend-cut risk. Had the market priced a dividend reaffirmed on better forward ROE, the stock would not have fallen 3% into the print, and BofA and JPM would not have cut targets to $8-8.50 on Oct 16.
findings.independence: Q2 call transcript (https://www.webull.com/news/15265674107692032). Pulte GSE buying (https://www.scotsmanguide.com/news/chla-presses-pulte-and-bessent-to-expand-agency-mbs-purchases/). October dividend declared (https://finviz.com/news/400001/agnc-investment-corp-declares-monthly-common-stock-dividend-of-012-per-common-share-for-october-2026).

findings.finding: Expectations were cut hard in the week before the print. Price targets went to $9 from $11 (KBW, Oct 7), $10 from $12 (Piper, Oct 9), $8.50 from $10.50 (BofA, Oct 16) and $8 from $11 (JPM, Oct 16). Wall Street Zen downgraded to Sell (Oct 17-18). Short interest rose 20.9% m/m to 11.1% of float. The stock sits at its 52-week low ($8.42, -30.8% from the high), -15.5% over 20 days and -3% on the print day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The baseline's 8 prints were up 6 times, with a median |move| of 1.41%. The largest up moves came after drawdowns: +3.55% in April 2025 and +3.14% in January 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself, so its value is as a lowered bar. A relief move needs the TBV and QTD numbers to come in no worse than the low marks. The +4.33 skew says options buyers expect more downside. Short interest at 2.6 days to cover is not crowded enough to force a squeeze, which is why this finding is small.
findings.independence: BofA and JPM cuts via CNBC/TheFly in search results. Equibles short interest (https://equibles.com/stocks/AGNC). KBW cut (https://www.tipranks.com/news/the-fly/agnc-investment-price-target-lowered-to-9-from-11-at-keefe-bruyette-thefly-news).

findings.finding: Net spread and dollar roll income is likely near the $0.39 consensus. Q2 printed $0.40 (beating $0.389) on a 2.89% cost of funds with 73% of funding hedged. The Fed hiked to 3.75-4.00% on Sep 16, and IVR's 9/30 repo rate was 3.97% against a 3.90% swap receive rate. Higher short rates therefore lift repo cost but also swap income on the hedged book, so the net effect is small and slightly negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: EPS has rarely moved AGNC. In July 2026 a $0.40 vs $0.389 beat came with a -1.28% move, because the stock trades on TBV.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced and small. A big earnings-power shift would show up as a dividend change, and the Oct 7-8 declaration of $0.12 suggests none is coming.

findings.finding: AGNC carries the highest price-to-book among the mortgage REITs Insider Monkey compared: 1.11x on the Oct 13 close of $8.61, against 0.76-1.05 for the others. A confirmed double-digit TBV decline therefore leaves the premium exposed to compression on the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In October 2023, after TBV fell 14%, the stock fell ~13% over the week, faster than book, so the premium compressed.
findings.why_not_priced: The book basis behind the 1.11x is not stated (it implies about $7.76). If the market had already marked AGNC to a peer-like ~$7.3 book, the premium would sit near 1.15x. That is high for a quarter of book loss, and its persistence suggests the market credits AGNC's franchise more than a confirmed number may support.
findings.independence: This shares its underlying concern with findings 1 and 2 (the size of the TBV hit), but the fact is different: the valuation premium, not the book change. No independent source for the peer P/B figures.

outside_window.finding: The November monthly dividend declaration (usually early in the month) is the first point at which a cut could appear. If Q3 net spread income held near $0.38-0.40, a cut is unlikely, but it would land after the window.

baseline_tension: The net lean is negative and agrees with the +4.33 downside skew and the -15.5% run-up. That suggests most of the bad Q3 book is priced, so p_up stays near 50 (45) and not lower. The two positives (a lowered bar and forward-ROE framing) cut against the skew and are kept small, because short interest at 2.6 days to cover is not a squeeze setup.
lessons_applied: Lesson 7: the positioning/lowered-bar positive runs against the +4.33 downside skew and short interest is not crowded (2.6 days to cover), so it was cut from +0.5 to +0.4.
Lesson 6: the TBV bar is unsourced (inferred from peers and price-target cuts), so the TBV-dependent findings stay capped small; the EPS bar of $0.39 rests on two aggregators.
Lesson 5: the October mortgage-rate proxy is kept as a small finding and labelled a proxy; the peer prints (ORC, IVR) count as counterparty-level documents dated after AGNC last spoke and are kept.
Nothing else changed: abs_move_pct 3.5 and p_up 45 are unchanged.
